categories.main_business_segments: Unisplendour Corporation Limited (000938.SZ) primarily operates in the digital and AI solutions sector, offering full-stack intelligent ICT infrastructure including network equipment, servers, storage products, cloud and intelligent platforms, active security, and smart terminals. The company serves diverse industries such as government, telecom operators, internet, finance, education, healthcare, agriculture, transportation, energy, and manufacturing. Its business is segmented into digital business, distribution business, and others, with a focus on ICT infrastructure and services accounting for nearly 69% of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in cloud computing, AI, big data, IoT, and next-generation information infrastructure. It develops proprietary platforms and software such as Paning OS, Comware, AD-NET, U-Center, CloudOS, and ONEStor, alongside hardware including AI servers, edge servers, high-density switches, and storage solutions. It emphasizes innovation in AI-enabled products, distributed cloud, high-performance computing clusters, and green energy-efficient liquid cooling technologies. R&D is a core focus with over 6,900 R&D personnel and significant investment in AI, cloud, network, security, and storage technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company’s primary customers include government agencies, telecom operators, internet companies, financial institutions, educational institutions, healthcare providers, energy companies, transportation authorities, and manufacturing enterprises. It has extensive involvement in national and regional digital government projects, telecom backbone networks, financial cloud innovations, smart city initiatives, and industrial digital transformation. The company also serves international markets across Asia, Europe, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.geographic_coverage: Unisplendour operates mainly in China, with domestic revenue accounting for over 96% of total sales. It has expanded its global footprint with 22 overseas branches in regions including Asia, Europe, Africa, and Latin America. The company has established subsidiaries and regional headquarters in countries such as South Korea, Uzbekistan, Chile, Poland, Germany, and Saudi Arabia, serving customers in over 180 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the ICT supply chain, focusing on the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of ICT hardware and software products, as well as providing integrated digital and AI solutions. It also offers system integration, software development, and lifecycle services, positioning itself as a comprehensive digital infrastructure and solutions provider rather than a raw materials supplier or pure distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus centers on the 'compute x connect' core, advancing full-stack AI-enabled ICT infrastructure including cloud, network, security, compute, storage, and terminals. The company pursues innovation in AIGC (AI-generated content), large AI models, distributed cloud, high-density networking, intelligent storage, active security, and green energy technologies. It emphasizes industry-specific AI applications, private domain large models, and integrated AI platforms to accelerate digital transformation across sectors. R&D investment remains robust, targeting breakthroughs in AI, cloud-native technologies, edge computing, and intelligent operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of ICT hardware (network devices, servers, storage, security equipment, smart terminals) and software platforms, as well as through service contracts including cloud services, system integration, maintenance, and digital transformation solutions. The company also earns income from licensing, government subsidies, and financial investments. Sales are conducted via both direct sales and extensive distribution channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Unisplendour is positioned as a leading digital and AI solutions provider in China, holding top market shares in multiple ICT product categories such as enterprise network switches, routers, WLAN, blade servers, UTM firewalls, and hyper-converged infrastructure. It competes with major domestic and international ICT vendors in networking, cloud computing, and AI infrastructure. The company leverages its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and broad customer base to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 79.0 billion, representing a 2.22% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.57 billion, with a decline compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached about RMB 88.8 billion, showing steady growth. R&D expenditure was RMB 5.1 billion, accounting for 6.46% of revenue. The company has a large workforce of over 17,000 employees, including nearly 7,000 in R&D roles. It continues to expand its global presence and invest in strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Unisplendour emphasizes its unique value as a global leading provider of integrated digital and AI solutions with a full-stack ICT infrastructure portfolio. Its differentiation lies in its comprehensive one-stop digital transformation solutions, deep industry expertise, proprietary AI large models, and advanced cloud-native and edge computing technologies. The company’s strong innovation capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to deliver customized, high-performance, and secure AI-enabled products and services enable it to meet diverse customer needs and drive intelligent upgrades across multiple industries.
